payload.title: The five pre-registered G1 field names bind to nothing: they are second names for numbers recorded under other keys (role_fitness mutation_canary rates, performance_kpis implementer rate, scorecard learning_log.live), and no function maps a name to its recorded key path or builds the flat report g1_gap_free_run reads, so fed the real fitness row it reports every field none
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/role_fitness.py:225-226 (the number is recorded as mutant_detection_rate and false_claim_refutation_rate)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/role_fitness.py:272 (nested under role_fitness.mutation_canary in the fitness row)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/agent_eval.py:1365 (recorded as live.repeat_failure_rate.implementer, nested in implementation_quality at fitness.py:88)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/autonomy_evidence.py:4743-4750 (g1_gap_free_run reads report.get(name) on a flat {name: value} report nothing builds)
docs/aria/generated/OWNERSHIP-ATLAS.md:31 (mechanism_contribution and its scorecard caller read liveness dead)
payload.rule_violated: F1.2 spec item 1: each lens field names the ledger and the owner of its number, one owner per number; a name that no code binds to its recorded location is a second, unpinned name (CLAUDE.md single-center rule).
payload.notes: The review's probe, reproduced by reading: a fitness row generated on a bound store, fed to g1_gap_free_run with gates_policy()['g1']['fields'], finds none of the five keys at the top level (canary rates live under role_fitness.mutation_canary, the implementer rate under implementation_quality.live.repeat_failure_rate.implementer, learning_log_live under mechanism_scorecard()['learning_log']), so every field reads none, run 0, no first gap (a never-measured field is deliberately not a gap). No production code calls mechanism_scorecard, g1_gap_free_run or gates_policy, so G1 cannot be evaluated from recorded state until some owner writes the name-to-path map; whoever does must invent it. Close condition: Give MeasuredField the key path of its number in the ledger it names, add one function that builds a cycle's flat G1 report from the fitness row and mechanism_scorecard through those paths, and call it from the fitness phase or doctor; a test feeds a real generate_fitness_report row to g1_gap_free_run and asserts the canary and implementer fields read measured when their numbers exist. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
